title: Namaz of Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.)
introduction:
NAMAZ OF IMAM AL-BAQIR (A)

A sacred two-unit prayer transmitted from Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (a.s.) with great spiritual rewards.

verses.translation: This prayer consists of two units in each of which Surah al-Faatehah is recited once and the following litany is repeated one hundred times:
there is no god save Allah,
